research_notes: A useful final metric for policy comparison is recovered useful seconds per wall-clock hour, including relay gaps and failed-tail loss.
This makes the cost of both conservative handoffs and aggressive failures visible in one operational measure.
Secondary metrics remain necessary to diagnose why two policies differ.
The cap validation phase should establish reliability before optimizing this aggregate metric.
Parallel workers may later raise the numerator during overlap but also add coordination overhead and conflict risk.
Those effects remain outside the present strict runtime sample.
